title_zh: 从备份找回录音并试听核对

scenario.goal_zh: 从昨日备份恢复误删录音，并通过播放开头与结尾核对文件内容

context_zh: 工作室同事使用本地项目备份找回误删的访谈录音。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I deleted the interview recording by mistake. Can we recover it?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: There is a backup from yesterday. I can restore the file to a separate folder so we do not overwrite anything.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Please do. The file should start with Rosa introducing herself.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: The recovery has finished. Here is the file; let us play the beginning.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: That's Rosa's introduction. Now check the end, where she thanks the volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I can hear that too. The recording runs for the full eighteen minutes.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Good, we've got the right recording back. I'll copy this checked version into the project folder.

targets.sense_zh: 找回遗失或删除的数据
